reviewRules: The canonical Proper raw Common is not sufficient to infer §498 without excluding feast and seasonal Prefaces.
The original source may contain an older prefatio as well as a '(rubrica 1960)' override; the latter has selection precedence.
Marian-feast §495 candidates do not authorize optional 2020/local Prefaces or overwrite the Mass reader.
